# DESIGN.md Catalog

84 design systems. The file for `<slug>` is `design-md/<slug>/DESIGN.md` at the repository root.

Format: `tokens` = YAML front matter with named tokens (`{colors.primary}`) plus Overview/Colors/Typography/Layout/Elevation & Depth/Shapes/Components/Do's and Don'ts sections; `prose` = numbered sections 1-9 ending in an Agent Prompt Guide.
